hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Shear screws
function: The screws through the housing into the inner sleeve that hold it closed until the seated ball's differential shears them.

tabs.overview: Number and size set the shift pressure; sheared stubs stay in the housing.
tabs.engineering: Shear value above the casing test pressure.
tabs.safety: A low shear value risks a premature shift during the casing test.
tabs.evidence: Completion codes article (S34), ball injector patent (S35), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
